description: Header file defining constexpr parser for string formatting in Abseil C++ library, including enums, structs, classes, and parsing functions for format specifiers.

classes.name: UnboundConversion
classes.description: Represents a single string format conversion with properties like argument position, width, precision, flags, length modifier, and conversion character.

classes.name: ConvTag
classes.description: Helper class for fast lookup and checking of format conversion characters, length modifiers, and flags.

classes.name: ConvTagHolder
classes.description: Holds a static table of ConvTag entries for all possible characters.

methods.name: GetTagForChar
methods.description: Returns the ConvTag for a given character, used for parsing format specifiers.

methods.name: CheckFastPathSetting
methods.description: Checks if the conversion can be optimized based on its properties.

methods.name: ParseDigits
methods.description: Parses a sequence of digits from the format string.

methods.name: ConsumeConversion
methods.description: Parses a format conversion specifier, updating the UnboundConversion object.

methods.name: ConsumeUnboundConversion
methods.description: Entry point for consuming a format specifier, handling positional and non-positional cases.
